text: The bug is clear: `get()` returns the value but never re-inserts the key, so a read doesn't update recency. The fix is to move the key to the end of the dict on a hit.

arguments.summary: Fixed the LRU cache bug where reads didn't count as use: in `LRUCache.get()` (lru/cache.py), a cache hit now re-inserts the key (del + reassign) to move it to the most-recently-used position in the underlying dict, so subsequent evictions drop the true least-recently-used key. Verified with the repo...
